summary: Full backend + frontend test of CG Unit 1 revision booklet. Backend: 21 pytest cases (GET /api/, /api/units, /api/units/cg-unit-1, 404 case, 10-topic structure, all 7-step fields, final_sections counts 10/15/8/8, DDA solved example table 7 rows + exact pixels) — all passed. Frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): cover, sidebar (10 topics + 4 section buttons), all 10 topic cards with 7 steps + SVG diagram, DDA solved example with 7-row pixel table, 4 final sections (8 gallery SVGs, 8 templates, 15 definitions, 10 last-minute rows), scroll-spy active highlighting, print button calling window.print() exactly once (verified via stubbed print + stack trace), print-media emulation (sidebar/header hidden, clean B&W-friendly A4 layout), zero console errors. One mobile navigation defect found.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking an item in the mobile menu over-scrolls: target card top lands at y = -410px (topic header/analogy off-screen above viewport, user lands mid-card at step 3). Root cause: navigate() calls setMenuOpen(false) and scrollIntoView() in the same tick, so the scroll offset is computed while the ~470px-tall open menu is still in the DOM; React then removes the menu and content shifts up by that height. Desktop sidebar navigation is correct (card top y = 96px). Suggested fix: close the menu first, then scroll on the next frame (requestAnimationFrame / setTimeout 0) or use a scroll-margin-aware manual window.scrollTo after re-layout.

action_items: Fix mobile menu over-scroll in App.js navigate(): defer scrollIntoView until after the menu unmounts (rAF/setTimeout) so the topic header is visible after navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js navigate(): state update (menu close) and scrollIntoView in the same tick causes layout-shift over-scroll on mobile — sequence them.
index.js wires QueryClientProvider but App.js fetches with raw axios in useEffect; either use react-query or drop the provider (dead dependency).
No retry / user-visible retry button on fetch failure — only a static 'Please refresh' message (data-testid=load-error). Acceptable for MVP but consider a retry action.
Backend has no Pydantic response models; content is returned raw from Mongo. Fine for a read-only content API, but consider a response_model for contract safety.
seed_data_creation: None — unit content is seeded by backend lifespan startup; tests are read-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (21 tests, all pass; run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q). DDA solved_example schema is {title, given, steps[], table:{headers[5], rows[7]}, note} — not a flat list. Only open bug: mobile (390px) menu navigation over-scrolls by ~410px; desktop nav/scroll-spy is correct. Print button verified to call window.print() once; print-media emulation renders cleanly.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile over-scroll: setMenuOpen(false) + document.getElementById(id).scrollIntoView() run synchronously in navigate(); the browser computes the scroll target using pre-unmount layout (open menu adds ~410-470px above content), so after React removes the menu the page ends up scrolled ~410px too far.
